CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenh_keep_packed_bundle_type()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if old.bundle_stock_mode='packed' and (new.bundle_stock_mode is distinct from old.bundle_stock_mode or new.product_type is distinct from old.product_type) then raise exception 'A packed bundle must remain a bundle.';end if;
 return new;
end;$function$
